verdict.rationale: Vercel's REST API docs show per-endpoint version segments in paths (e.g. /v6/deployments, /v3/deployments/{idOrUrl}/events), so the API is versioned. The pack contains no documented deprecation policy, sunset timeline, or versioning guarantees, which leaves half the story unsupported. missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, explicit versioning guarantees or changelog of version retirements, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: To access resources owned by a team, append the Team ID as a query string: https://api.vercel.com/v6/deployments?teamId=[teamID]
